parent_card_induction.name: Audit and Pivot an Assumption
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: Name the inherited assumption; show why it is load-bearing; pivot its locus, strength or representation; test the changed condition.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when several recent methods inherit the same unexamined prerequisite and the proposed change can produce a qualitatively new result.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The result is unchanged after the relaxation. / An equally strong or unverifiable assumption is smuggled back in.

parent_card_induction.name: Substitute the Operator or Representation
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: Identify where the old object loses information or creates cost; substitute a new object; isolate the changed object from all other components.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when the task is adequate but the current operator or representation is the binding limitation.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

parent_card_induction.name: Liberate a Fixed Generative Component
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: Find a component whose output space is fixed; change its generation process or factorization; preserve the surrounding evaluation contract.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when a fixed policy, generator or actuation primitive prevents a desired behavior despite adequate supervision or data.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

parent_card_induction.name: Design a Confound-Isolating Diagnostic
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: Name one load-bearing variable; perturb it while holding the remaining interface fixed; predict a downstream outcome and include a semantic control.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when a system result can be explained by sensing, compute, data, tuning, human adaptation or another non-mechanistic confound.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

parent_card_induction.name: Unify Heterogeneous Inputs into One Space
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: Identify the incompatible modalities, embodiments or agents; define a common state or message space; demonstrate the information is used by the decision or control loop.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when the gap is caused by modality, embodiment, sensor or agent fragmentation rather than a missing predictor alone.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

parent_card_induction.name: Reframe as a Solvable Object
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: State the native intractable formulation; define a solvable surrogate with a conservation or approximation argument; test the gap between the two.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when the native robot problem is underconstrained, combinatorial, long-horizon or physically inaccessible in its current form.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

parent_card_induction.name: Manufacture the Supervisory Signal
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: Locate the missing supervisory information; derive it from demonstrations, contrasts, physics, human feedback or self-consistency; validate that it changes the target behavior.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when data exist but the available label, reward or feedback is too sparse, delayed, unsafe or semantically misaligned.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

parent_card_induction.name: Encode Structure by Construction
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: Name the invariant or constraint; encode it in morphology, representation, controller, architecture or protocol; test behavior outside the construction examples.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when a structural law is known and repeatedly rediscovered by data, or when deployment requires a guarantee that tuning cannot provide.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

parent_card_induction.name: Prove Equivalence to Unify
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: State the two objects; derive the mapping and its assumptions; use the equivalence to remove duplicated machinery or expose a new controllable quantity.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when parallel literatures optimize the same object under different names or when a proof can collapse an apparent trade-off.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

parent_card_induction.name: Decompose for Differentiated Treatment
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: Identify the hidden heterogeneity; partition it by a measurable criterion; allocate distinct mechanisms or policies; test the partition boundary.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when one policy, model or controller is forced to average across regimes with incompatible requirements.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

parent_card_induction.name: Decompose and Delegate to Solvers
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: Define the subproblem interfaces; assign each solver a responsibility; verify composition and recovery when a solver fails.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when a long-horizon or multi-agent problem contains reusable subproblems with different algorithmic structure.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

parent_card_induction.name: Relax Discrete Search to Continuous
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: Specify the discrete object; build a continuous relaxation; characterize the relaxation gap and recovery procedure.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when planning, allocation or design is combinatorial but its geometry admits a meaningful continuous proxy.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

parent_card_induction.name: Adapt by Conditioning, Not Retraining
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: Expose the changing context; encode it as a condition or online estimate; test adaptation under distribution shift and frozen-core controls.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when online changes are real but full retraining is too slow, unsafe, data hungry or difficult to certify.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

parent_card_induction.name: Characterize a Limit, Then Surpass It
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: State the old limit; prove or measure it under the same regime; introduce one change; show a strict and reproducible improvement.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when a field has a sharp stability, planning, sample, sensing, bandwidth or safety boundary that can be made explicit.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

parent_card_induction.name: Design a Property-Targeting Pretext Objective
parent_card_induction.reusable_capability: Name the downstream property; create a pretext that makes it observable; verify transfer and remove the auxiliary objective as a control.
parent_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when the desired property is latent, expensive to label or poorly represented by generic self-supervision.
parent_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proposed change is not load-bearing or its evidence cannot separate it from a simpler explanation.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Relocate the load-bearing locus
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Move the enforcement, sensing or control locus to an overlooked state, interface or representation.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when every prior method assumes the same location contains the decisive signal.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The new locus was already used by a close paper. / The move only changes implementation vocabulary.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Remove a fixed model assumption
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Replace a required model, calibration or distributional assumption with a weaker observable condition.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when the robot must operate under unknown contact, friction, terrain or dynamics.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: An equally strong hidden model is reintroduced.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Replace a distributional condition with a structural one
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Move from a fragile statistical prior to a geometric, architectural or interface constraint.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when data coverage is insufficient but physical or system structure is reliable.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The structural condition is merely a renamed distributional assumption.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Characterize the adversarial boundary
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Treat a claimed safety, robustness or imperceptibility property as a budget that can be challenged.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when the operating or threat model is stronger than the paper's nominal test.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: Only a static or weak adversary is tested.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Pivot the system interface
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Move the load-bearing computation across a sensing, communication, human or actuation interface.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when interface latency, bandwidth or authority is the inherited bottleneck.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The interface is changed without a causal account.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Isolate a failure-causing convention
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Turn a field convention into an intervention and measure the failure it causes.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when benchmark success hides a known deployment failure.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The failure is anecdotal or benchmark-specific.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Low-sensitivity operator substitution
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Replace an operator whose output is overly sensitive to noise, contact or discretization.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when the same task has a brittle operator-level failure.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The gain is only a larger or more heavily tuned model.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Curvature-object substitution
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Substitute a scalar or local object with curvature, geometry or distributional structure that preserves the missing signal.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when point estimates discard the signal needed for robust state or control.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The richer object is used only as an unexamined feature.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Representation-level state substitution
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Replace the state representation used by estimation, planning or learning.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when the raw state is not invariant to embodiment, viewpoint or contact.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The representation is an opaque embedding with no failure boundary.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Contact and geometry operator substitution
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Replace a contact, collision or geometry operation with one that exposes the relevant physical object.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when contact-rich manipulation or non-Euclidean planning is bottlenecked by a standard operator.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The operator is a cosmetic reparameterization.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Generative process redesign
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Change how actions, trajectories or forces are generated instead of adding a downstream correction.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when a fixed policy or generator cannot express the required behavior.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The generator is only wrapped by off-the-shelf modules.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Residual mechanism liberation
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Expose the physical or modeling residual that a fixed generator cannot explain.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when sim-to-real, friction, contact or dynamics residuals dominate the error.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The residual model becomes a generic error-corrector with no mechanism.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Policy-generation substrate redesign
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Change the substrate or factorization from which a policy generates actions.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when policy expressivity or long-horizon composition is limiting deployment.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: Scaling or data alone explains the result.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Controlled diagnostic construction
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Build a one-variable-isolated intervention or measurement instrument.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when a robot claim can be explained by hardware, data, tuning or human adaptation confounds.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: Only the intermediate metric changes, not the task outcome.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Cross-modal shared representation
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Align vision, touch, language, proprioception or force into a task-usable state.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when modalities are complementary but not jointly actionable.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The common space is a concatenation with no causal use.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Sequential-control re-casting
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Recast long-horizon control as a sequence of measurable subgoals or phases.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when a single objective dilutes credit or hides the decisive phase.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The phases are arbitrary labels with no mechanism.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Intractable-problem re-casting
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Turn a native intractable planning or contact problem into a solvable object with a bounded gap.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when direct optimization is combinatorial, discontinuous or physically inaccessible.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The reframe is a renamed heuristic.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Feasibility-object re-casting
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Replace an open-ended deployment goal with an explicit operating envelope and feasibility object.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when field performance fails because the target was never bounded.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The envelope is selected after seeing the result.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Self-supervised signal engineering
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Derive supervision from temporal, geometric, cross-view or task consistency.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when robot labels are expensive but structure is observable.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The pretext is generic and unrelated to the task.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Residual and latent supervisory signal
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Use model residuals, uncertainty or latent disagreement as the training/adaptation signal.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when the error itself identifies where the policy or estimator must change.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: Residual magnitude is optimized as a proxy with no task effect.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Human or environment feedback as supervision
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Convert intervention, preference, success/failure or contact feedback into a stable learning signal.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when direct reward or labels are absent but the robot already interacts.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The system treats feedback as free or ignores operator adaptation.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Symmetry-group construction
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Encode a symmetry or invariance into the state, model or controller.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when changes of frame, viewpoint, embodiment or ordering should not change the decision.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The claimed symmetry is not present in the physical task.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Relational topology encoded as structure
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Encode contact, graph, topology or relational geometry as a structural prior.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when relations, not individual observations, determine the robot outcome.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: A topology-as-prior architecture is presented without isolating its work.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Embodiment and contact constraint by construction
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Build morphology, compliance, contact or actuator constraints directly into the robot mechanism or controller.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when embodiment is the source of the capability, not merely a test platform.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: One hardware instance is generalized to all embodiments without evidence.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Equivalence-based objective unification
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Prove that two control, learning or planning objectives are equivalent in a named regime.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when a duplicated objective or apparent trade-off blocks a simpler design.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The proof only renames the objective.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Heterogeneous regime decomposition
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Split contact, terrain, object, user or agent regimes and allocate distinct treatment.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when a single controller or policy averages incompatible regimes.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The partition is tuned after results or has no operational meaning.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Decompose and delegate to solvers
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Give typed subproblems to specialized planners, learned policies, agents or tools.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when planning or coordination contains separable subproblems.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: A pipeline of modules is called a contribution without a unifying interface.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Discrete-search relaxation to continuous
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Relax combinatorial planning or allocation into a differentiable or continuous object with recovery.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when a discrete robot decision has exploitable geometry.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The post-process secretly solves the original problem at full cost.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Adapt by conditioning
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Condition a frozen core on the current robot, environment, user or task state.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when the shift is local, recurrent and observable online.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The method retrains while calling it conditioning.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Limit characterization and strict surpass
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Establish a stability, safety, bandwidth, sample or planning boundary, then exceed it with a named mechanism.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when a matched baseline has a sharp and reproducible boundary.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: Only an empirical improvement is shown with no boundary or tightness.

subpattern_card_induction.name: Property-targeting pretext objective
subpattern_card_induction.reusable_capability: Train on the robot property that must transfer: contact, invariance, uncertainty, affordance or safety.
subpattern_card_induction.when_to_apply: Use when generic self-supervision does not represent the property needed downstream.
subpattern_card_induction.failure_boundary: The property is named after the result or is not observable.

non_claims: Cluster IDs and counts are not scientific findings.
The 15/31 vocabulary remains a reusable reasoning library, not an empirical taxonomy.
No award, venue, presentation, or count is treated as a decision outcome.
